# Thrivefold — System Architecture & Knowledge for AI Agents & Search Engines

> **Platform**: Thrivefold  
> **Ecosystem**: Amit Dev Labs (https://devamit.co.in)  
> **Production URL**: https://thrivefold.devamit.co.in  
> **Repository**: https://github.com/devamitch/thrivefold-site  
> **Core Engine**: React Native (Expo 55), MMKV Local Vault, On-Device Classifier, Supabase Zero-Knowledge Sync  

---

## 1. What is Thrivefold?
Thrivefold is a local-first, privacy-sovereign health, wellbeing, and slow-correspondence ecosystem built on modern Expo React Native for iOS, Android, and Web. Inspired by the calm design language of Setu and the gamified sensory feedback loops of BlinkQuest, Thrivefold delivers an intentional, humane, and deeply private mobile experience.

### Three Dedicated Health Spaces:
1. **Women's Health**: Cycle tracking, luteal/follicular phase nutrition, hormonal wellness, basal body temperature, pelvic floor reminders, and reproductive autonomy.
2. **Men's Health**: Stamina, hormonal balance, mental resilience, workout telemetry, circadian sun exposure, VO2 max progression, and recovery.
3. **Pride & LGBTQ+ Wellbeing**: Gender-affirming health milestones, HRT schedule reminders, injection site rotation, identity-safe reflections, mental wellness, and affirming health navigators.

---

## 2. Slow Correspondence Engine (Postal Letters)
Thrivefold replaces instant messaging addiction with the contemplative cadence of pen-pal postal letters.
- **Chip-Only Composer**: Users construct letters exclusively by selecting curated sentiment cards, health reflections, and wellness inquiries. Zero unstructured text input prevents toxic spam, phone number extraction, and harassment.
- **Distance-Delayed Delivery**: Letters take hours to days to arrive based on simulated geographical distance, fostering thoughtful, asynchronous contemplation.
- **Pseudonymous Pen-Pal Discovery**: Match based on shared health interests without revealing real identities.

---

## 3. Zero-Trust Safety & Policy Engine
- **18+ Adult Age Assurance**: Required for all pen-pal and correspondence features.
- **7-Day Restricted Trial for Under-25 Cohorts**: Hard quota of 1 intro/day and complete isolation from community directories.
- **Deterministic Policy Classifier**: Evaluates all interactions on-device before sync.
